Description: Homepage loads with marketplace layout, search chrome, and store benefits.
Header menu links open shop, seller onboarding, and order tracking.
Footer policy, support, and help links open the correct pages.
Shop by Department dropdown opens a category listing.
Buyer searches a keyword and sees matching products.
System displays a no-results message for an unmatched keyword.
System still loads search results for a misspelled term.
Product, category, or brand suggestions appear as the buyer types.
Search or shop results can be filtered by category.
Results sort by price low to high and high to low.
Buyer opens a product page from search results.
Logo click returns the shopper to the homepage.
Mobile hamburger/bottom menu opens site navigation.
Breadcrumbs recover the previous listing or home.
